# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test fixtures needed for integration testing.
Please place sample PDF and image files here.

## Required Fixtures:
- `valid-small.pdf` (Minimal valid PDF for testing)
- `invalid.pdf` (Corrupted PDF missing headers/trailers)
- `large-100mb.pdf` (Large PDF for load testing)
- `sample-image.jpg` (Sample JPG for testing JPG-to-PDF)
- `multipage.pdf` (PDF with multiple pages for split testing)
